notes: Three branches end at their own names and «كل هؤلاء عن قتادة» converges them: the Qatada level and the closing back-reference form the shared tail (rule 3)
«إلا في رواية أبي كامل وحده عن أبي عوانة» names a different transmitter for a remark on one wording: stored as a variant group, not a route

Wording differences (the added phrase in Jarir's version, «وإذا قرأ فأنصتوا») are left out; the exchange after «قال أبو إسحاق» between Muslim and Abu Bakr ibn Ukht Abi al-Nadr is commentary, not a chain
«أبي» in the second branch is a relation (rule 7); the first occurrence of the word is inside «ابن أبي شيبة», so the relation is the second occurrence
